events.description: Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Carol Willick will need to make important co-parenting decisions about Ben Geller and asks how their decision-making will work.
Carol Willick asks Ross Geller to give an example of the kind of decision Ross Geller means.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller does not know and suggests discussing deciding Ben Geller’s name as an example.
Carol Willick says Carol Willick plans to name Ben Geller Marlon if Ben Geller is a boy and Minnie if Ben Geller is a girl.
Ross Geller says that when Carol Willick says the baby name "Minnie," Ross Geller hears "Mouse."
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch and Carol Willick agreed on choosing "Minnie" as Ben Geller’s name.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Carol Willick agreed in the past that Ross Geller and Carol Willick would spend the rest of their lives together.
Ross Geller says the situation is funny.
Ross Geller says Susan Bunch and Carol Willick should roll with the punches and adapt to the changes.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller believes the baby name "Julia" is now on the table for consideration.
